title: Quantum Prayers - Coherence, Consciousness and the Art of Aligned Prayer
author: Ethan James Farrell
description: The foundational custom text of Ethan's Quantum Prayers framework (June 2026 edition), compiled from original teachings together with syntheses of scientific research. Chapter I organises prayers by subject. Chapter II offers expanded syntheses on consciousness, coherence and choice, with sections on the theoretical case for prayer as a 'quantum technology', the observer effect and conscious collapse, the neuroscience of prayer, coherence as the master key, quantum intercession (praying for others), regulation of the nervous system as the foundation of practice, and conscious manifestation beyond the popular law of attraction. The book uses physics concepts as interpretive metaphors for intention, attention and spiritual alignment rather than as laboratory claims. It is the parent volume of A Quantum Coherence Corpus and serves as the conceptual reference for that prayer collection.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection.
